es.a: Atendemos de lunes a sábado. Consultá nuestros horarios actualizados al final de la página.
Podés reservar desde el botón 'Reservar' en el menú o contactarnos directamente por Messaging.

en.a: We're open Monday through Saturday. Check our current hours at the bottom of the page.

en.q: How do I book an appointment?
en.a: You can book from the 'Book' button in the menu or contact us directly on Messaging.

en.q: Do you accept transfers or cards?
en.a: Yes, we accept cash, transfers, and cards. Ask about cash payment promotions.
Check our address in the contact section at the bottom of the page.
